assumptions.clock: one economic period per START, not month/year

freeze.policies: course reserve-constrained; unchanged fixed ticket sizes and visible exits; liquidity bank term1 and 20M reserve; risk-aware max25% per financial asset, lowest volatility stock, half stock ticket in uncertain, no stressed/late credit; novice unchanged synthetic uniform noise
freeze.reserveControls: 0/5/10/15M; same savings/stocks/diversified, tickets, course ROI, exits, funding order and seeds; discretionary investments/course limited by cash-reserve, mandatory costs unrestricted. Portfolio exposure changes intentionally; not an isolated cash effect.
freeze.expansionGate: Expand max3 candidates if personal exposure changes >=10pp, mandatory shortage changes >=5pp, or worst-decile trade-off >=2M and could alter educational choice. Separate 400-seed holdout; freeze before running; no tuning after holdout.
freeze.economyControl: D adopts B economy, retains 20-tile D layout/5 START. Compare to unchanged B; not pure causal tile-count effect.
